(01 — ABOUT ME)

Curious about data. Focused on insights.

I am a Data Analyst with an MBA in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science from SRM Institute of Science and Technology. My interest lies in exploring data, identifying patterns and translating analytical findings into meaningful business insights.

Project 01 · Nov 2025 – Dec 2025

Food Delivery Safety & Hygiene Perception Analysis

Analysed customer perceptions of food delivery hygiene, packaging quality, delivery safety and customer trust using survey data and statistical techniques.

  • Designed a 20-question survey and collected 138 responses.
  • Developed a statistically significant regression model (p < 0.001, Adjusted R² = 0.23).
  • Identified packaging quality and sealed delivery as important drivers of customer confidence.
  • Applied Chi-Square, ANOVA and correlation analysis.
PythonExcelGoogle FormsRegressionChi-SquareANOVA
View repository ↗
Question

Do customers trust food-delivery hygiene, and what drives that confidence?

Approach

A 20-question survey (138 responses), then regression, Chi-Square, ANOVA and correlation tests in Python.

Outcome

A significant model (p < 0.001, Adj. R² = 0.23) with packaging quality and sealed delivery as key drivers.

Project 02 · Mar 2025 – Apr 2025

Stock Price Forecasting Using Machine Learning

Explored machine learning approaches for stock price forecasting and designed an end-to-end forecasting workflow.

  • Reviewed nine published studies comparing stock forecasting methods.
  • Designed a forecasting workflow using Yahoo Finance data collection and feature engineering.
  • Used chronological train-test splitting to avoid data leakage.
  • Developed a sample forecasting dashboard.
PythonScikit-learnPandasMatplotlibPower BIPredictive ModellingTime Series

Daily closes up to 30 Apr 2025 (public dataset). First 80% of days train the model, the last 20% test it. A statistical demo, not financial advice.

Question

How reliably can machine learning forecast prices without leaking future data?

Approach

Reviewed nine studies, then built a Yahoo Finance → feature engineering → model pipeline with a chronological split.

Outcome

An end-to-end forecasting workflow and a working sample dashboard.

Project 03 · Sep 2023 – Oct 2023

Cricket Player Performance Analysis Dashboard

Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard to analyse cricket player performance and compare teams and players.

  • Analysed 5,000+ player records from 10+ countries.
  • Used Power Query for data cleaning and DAX for calculations.
  • Developed six interactive visuals for batting average, strike rate, rankings and performance trends.
